The construction proves unbounded quadratic many independent unobstructed directions for natural rank-one Rees/Munn algebras and shows their degeneracy permits a free deformation with generic fiber a simple full matrix algebra. This compares radical-cube-zero and central-simple associative structures uniformly over every field; not a small arbitrary numerical slice.
